name: How do I choose between steel-stud framing and wood framing for my project?
description: Choose steel for commercial fire compliance, straight walls, and termite protection; choose wood if your design relies on standard residential light-frame wood

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between steel-stud framing and wood framing for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose steel framing if you are building a commercial space, want unmatched fire resistance, or need completely straight, maintenance-free walls that never warp. Steel is the preferred choice for commercial interiors, tenant improvements, and modern basements because it meets strict non-combustible building codes. Choose wood if your project involves standard residential construction where local framers are primarily wood-oriented, or where exterior thermal bridging without foam sheathing is a concern. If your priority is termite immunity, dimensional stability, and crisp drywall finishes, steel framing is an outstanding alternative to traditional lumber.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose steel for commercial fire compliance, straight walls, and termite protection; choose wood if your design relies on standard residential light-frame wood conventions.
